title: NIMHANS Notification 2026 - Apply for 03 Project Research Scientist I, Project Technical Support III and Project Nurse II Posts
description: The National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bangalore (NIMHANS) has issued the official notification for 2026. Here we provide more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, ...
